title: No payload content in logs
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 2.2 Choosing between a DVC and a VHL; HCERT Specification, 6.1 HCERT Signature Validity Time. QR Code Generation, 2.2 Choosing between a DVC and a VHL: “All data is in the QR and is readable by anyone who scans it”.

statements.label: No payload content in logs
statements.requirement: The libraries SHALL NOT log payload content, HC1 strings or decoded claims at any default log level. A QR code holds readable personal data.
